now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#10
now.text: Jameson fires Eddie twice over stories about Spider-Man, and Eddie blames the hero for ruining his life.

now.on_b_card_about_a: A rival photographer of Eddie's at the Bugle.

evidence: Jameson first fires Eddie in an early Spider-Slayer episode after the fake Spider-Man unmasking, rehires him in #8 'The Alien Costume, Part 1', and fires him again in #9 'The Alien Costume, Part 2' when John reveals Eddie hid the Rhino; Eddie, evicted, blames Spider-Man. All of this happens before #10. Placed at #10 after the enemy stage, this 'rival' stage wrongly overrides the Venom enmity from #10 on (at the end of #10 Eddie is jailed in Ravencroft still bent on revenge, and returns as Venom in #37). Moving it to #9 puts it before stage 1 in story order.

The ghosts already blame Eli in S4E2.
